Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Cotsonika, Nicholas <ncotsonika@freepress.com>
Sent: Saturday, December 12, 2015 3:29 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Little thing
When you say “the team,” the subject is singular. You can’t follow it with “they.”
Just say “the Tigers” instead. Don’t worry so much about being repetitive. It sounds more natural than forcing “the team.”

The Tigersteam’s foremost goal this off-season was finding starting pitching. They did. Then building a bullpen. They did. But in that process, Avila had said since the outset of the off-season, they wanted to shy away from parting with pitching prospects. And they did.
